description: Creates a new run of Setup Audit for Claude on atilab.io and returns its run id, the URL of the run's private progress page, and the id and title of the first step. A run stores step statuses and short summaries only; no account or contact details are needed. Anyone who has the run id or the progress page URL can open the run. Each call creates a separate run.

path.description: Optional: which question the audit starts from. plan-choice: which plan and how many seats. stalled-rollout: Claude was bought and is hardly used. usage-limits: the team keeps reaching usage limits. data-safety: connecting Claude to company data. right-tool: Claude compared with other assistants. Every path starts with the quick check; the path sets which modules follow and their order.

name: atilab_audit_start
title: Start a Setup Audit run
